subtitle: 不愿顾此失彼

paragraphs.en: It looks like Avengers: Secret Wars will be the only Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) movie in 2027, as Kevin Feige has promised that Marvel Studios is committed to "focusing on quality."
paragraphs.cn: 看来《复仇者联盟：秘密战争》将是2027年唯一一部漫威电影宇宙（MCU）电影；Kevin Feige承诺，漫威影业会专注于「质量」。

paragraphs.en: When Marvel stepped off the Hall H stage at San Diego Comic-Con (SDCC) 2026, attendees in-person and at home were surprised to see Feige's crew come and go without mentioning any additional 2027 projects. Those keeping their MCU movie calendar updated will note that leaves the dates between Avengers: Doomsday 's premiere on December 18, 2026, and Secret Wars' premiere on December 17, 2027, completely vacant.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威结束2026年圣迭戈国际漫画展（SDCC）的Hall H舞台活动后，现场及线上观众都惊讶地发现，Feige的团队来去之间没有提及任何新增的2027年项目。一直更新MCU电影日程的观众会注意到，这让《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》2026年12月18日上映与《秘密战争》2027年12月17日上映之间的档期完全空了出来。

paragraphs.en: It's a 12-month drought – one of Marvel Studios' longest ever – as the superhero universe paves the way for a potentially universe-ending conclusion to Phase Six late next year. In an interview with Empire , the Marvel Studios boss clarified that the studio has a good reason for leaving its post-Doomsday schedule open.
paragraphs.cn: 这将形成长达12个月的空档，是漫威影业历史上最长的间隔之一；这个超级英雄宇宙正在为明年末第六阶段一场可能终结宇宙的收束做准备。漫威影业掌门人在接受《Empire》采访时澄清，工作室在《毁灭之日》之后留出档期有充分理由。

paragraphs.en: "A lot of it is a strategy we've talked about for a while, of focusing on quality," Feige explained. "We always try to focus on quality, but when quantity is so much, you get spread thin. We didn't want to be spread thin, and the Avengers is as important as it comes."
paragraphs.cn: Feige解释道：「这在很大程度上是我们讨论已久的策略：专注质量。我们一直努力关注质量，但当数量太多时，资源就会被摊薄。我们不想顾此失彼，而《复仇者联盟》的重要性无与伦比。」

paragraphs.en: It's an update to the Marvel Studios strategy it's talked about in the past. Viewers have spent the 2020s attributing their " superhero fatigue " to a release schedule that has previously seen as many as four movies released in a single calendar year (and that doesn't count all of the TV shows). To help ease the pressure, Disney announced in 2024 that it would be slowing down its releases to just two or three movies, and two TV shows per year.
paragraphs.cn: 这更新了漫威影业过去谈过的策略。进入2020年代后，观众一直把自己的「超级英雄疲劳」归因于过于密集的发行日程：该公司过去曾在一个自然年推出多达4部电影（还不包括所有剧集）。为缓解压力，迪士尼在2024年宣布将放慢发行节奏，改为每年只推出2至3部电影和2部剧集。

paragraphs.en: That same year happened to be one of the few with a single MCU movie premiere thanks to Deadpool & Wolverine's arrival in July. Still, its release followed just eight months after 2023's The Marvels. Captain America: Brave New World then arrived less than seven months later in February 2025.
paragraphs.cn: 同一年因《死侍与金刚狼》在7月上映，恰好成为少数只有一部MCU电影首映的年份之一。不过，该片距离2023年的《惊奇队长2》上映仅隔8个月；不到7个月后，《美国队长4：勇敢新世界》又在2025年2月上映。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day will end its own 12-month drought when it follows Fantastic Four: First Steps this Friday, July 31. Then, for the next year and a half, it's all about the Avengers.
paragraphs.cn: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》将在本周五（7月31日）接档《神奇四侠：初露锋芒》上映，结束自身长达12个月的空档。随后的一年半，舞台将全属《复仇者联盟》。

paragraphs.en: Feige reiterated the importance of Secret Wars in particular, calling it "a setup in and of itself to the future, to what's next." Though he's adamant that it's not an MCU reboot , he added, "So really, it was landing those two movies and setting up 2028, of which we’ve revealed two of them so far, Ghost Rider and Panther III .”
paragraphs.cn: Feige再次强调《秘密战争》尤其重要，称它「本身就是为未来、为下一步所作的铺垫」。他坚称这并非MCU重启，同时补充道：「所以归根结底，是让那两部电影落地并为2028年铺路；目前我们已经公布其中两部，分别是《恶灵骑士》和《黑豹3》。」

paragraphs.en: The two MCU movies were maybe the biggest announcements from the SDCC Hall H panel. Highlights include Ryan Gosling as Ghost Rider and David Jonsson as the next Black Panther . The former remains without a release date beyond its 2028 promise, with the latter set for December 15 of that year.
paragraphs.cn: 这两部MCU电影或许是SDCC Hall H专场公布的最大消息。重点包括Ryan Gosling饰演恶灵骑士，以及David Jonsson饰演下一任黑豹。前者除承诺2028年上映外仍未定档，后者则定于该年12月15日上映。

paragraphs.en: While the MCU will test die-hard fans' patience in 2027, moviegoers won't be entirely without theatrical releases from Marvel. So long as everything goes according to plan, Sony's Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse should help with the wait when it premieres June 18, 2027. On the TV side of things, Daredevil: Born Again Season 3 is slated for a 2027 release.
paragraphs.cn: MCU将在2027年考验铁杆粉丝的耐心，但影迷并非完全看不到漫威的院线作品。只要一切按计划进行，索尼的《蜘蛛侠：超越宇宙》将在2027年6月18日上映，帮助观众度过等待期；剧集方面，《夜魔侠：重生》第三季计划于2027年推出。

paragraphs.en: We'll get to see just how painful the wait will be when Avengers: Doomsday arrives this December. Until then, you can freshen up on everything Marvel has in the pipeline . You can also check out everything else announced at the Hall H panel .
paragraphs.cn: 等到《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》在今年12月上映时，我们就会知道这段等待究竟有多难熬。在此之前，可以回顾漫威正在推进的全部项目，也可查看Hall H专场公布的其他消息。

opus_summary: Feige称2027年仅上映《秘密战争》，漫威影业会质量优先。两部《复仇者联盟》电影为2028铺路；《蜘蛛侠：超越宇宙》与《夜魔侠：重生》仍计划2027年推出。
